name: Directorate of Administration
director: HIS EMINENCE, SUP. AP. GEN. DR. AYO AKINMOLADUN
bodyHtml:
Assist the Secretary of the Holy Order in developing strategy, leading, and implementing the church’s administrative duties and programs. The incumbent is responsible for working with the Secretary of the Holy Order to coordinate and supervise the daily operations of the Secretariat and to ensure implementation and compliance with Church regulations and internal policies.

The incumbent is also responsible for liaison with the Assistant Secretary of Logistics and Special Projects and the Assistant Secretary, Training & Development for planning an annual strategic retreat for the Advisory Board every February to articulate the strategic short-term, medium-term, and Long-term vision for the Church.

name: Directorate of Education/Scholarship and Employment
director: HIS EMINENCE, AP. GEN. DR. B. C. OKUNSEINDE
bodyHtml:
Provides vision, develops strategy, leads, and implements the church’s educational services and programs, and oversees the conceptualization and development of educational institutions at different levels for the Church. Evaluate the requirements from the different government (state and federal) educational standards boards for the set up of schools and educational services institutions for the church, and supervise such institutions.

The incumbent is responsible for identifying indigent and brilliant students of the church deserving of scholarship awards and, through the Scholarship board (for which he/she heads), recommends to the HME through the Advisory Board candidates for scholarship awards. He is responsible to interface and explore synergies with educational institutions to partner on opportunities for the church.

The incumbent is also responsible, in liaison with the Assistant Secretary Training and the Coordinator of the Mount Zion Youth Society (MZYS), to initiate programs and identify credible candidates from the MZYS Campus Fellowship.

name: Directorate of Evangelism, Ecumenism and Missions
director: HIS EMINENCE, SUP. AP. GEN. (DR) ISAAC BELLO
bodyHtml:
Provides vision, leadership, develops strategy, leads, and implements the church’s evangelism and mission ministries, and effectively manages ESOCS evangelical, missions, and ecumenical outreach.

The incumbent is responsible for overseeing and implementing the church's evangelism/mission ministries, training volunteers, and actively participating in the evangelism ministry to influence others for Christ and bring them into the church. This includes leading the effort to maintain a comprehensive missions program in the church.

He is responsible for exploring mission opportunities, keeping the church informed regarding potential and ongoing mission involvement, and serving as a liaison between the church and its missionaries and other Christian denominations and groups. The incumbent also coordinates efforts to provide content for all ESOCS literature like the Daily Devotional, Bible reading in Churchman’s pamphlet, etc., and mobilizes efforts of individuals, church ministries, small/growth groups, and other community and church based organizations for evangelism and transformational engagement with other churches and Christian-based groups (e.g. OIAC, CAN, PFN, WCC, etc). The incumbent also empowers the development and release of missional partnerships with other Christian denominations and groups.

name: Directorate of Finance
director: HIS EMINENCE, AP. GEN. (DR) B. E. O. EDEM, MFR
bodyHtml:
The Assistant Secretary Finance has the responsibility of ensuring that the Church’s financial operations are processed and reported accurately with integrity. This will include, but not be limited to, responsibility for the oversight, management, and leadership in the areas of finance, internal control, and auditing for the entire church.

The successful accomplishment of this position supports the church’s ministries for their use in furthering God’s kingdom The incumbent is responsible for providing and setting the Financial Reporting Standards and oversight for all the CMCs, Provinces, and Bands/Associations. The incumbent is also responsible for managing and improving the intrinsic financial/fiduciary value in the relationship between the Church and its banking partners. The position also serves to provide Financial Advisory Services and intelligence to the Church and as an interface.

He will also be required to integrate and coordinate the requirements and inputs of disciplines from the cross-section of the church for budgeting and reporting purposes. He will be the custodian of the Church’s financial books, accounts, and reporting documents.

name: Directorate of Logistics and Planning
director: HIS EMINENCE, SUP. AP. GEN. (DR) DERE OTUBU
bodyHtml:
Provides vision, leadership, develops strategy, leads, and implements the church’s 10- year development plan and other development initiatives. Also responsible for developing and delivering complex, large-scale implementations for new projects and supervising the planning and implementation of major Church events. The incumbent is responsible for planning, providing a road map, and implementing the general architecture of important Church events like the Annual Conferences, etc. He is to review and holistically set up the structure and processes to manage the church’s fixed and movable assets. Develop and implement a “best practice” process for inventory systems.

The incumbent will also be responsible for developing a standard protocol and travel guide for managing the Baba Aladura’s travel itinerary and logistical needs. He coordinates efforts to budget and implement the deployment of IT-based work tools for the effective running of the Church’s secretariat. Coordinate all efforts on IT solutions while working with the Media and publicity team to provide content.

name: Directorate of Audit and Monitoring
bodyHtml:
Provides vision, develops strategy, leads, and implements the church’s financial and process compliance standards. Sets process evaluation metrics for the organization and ensures accounting and financial records comply with government guidelines and laws.

The incumbent directs the auditing of accounting and financial data of various arms (CMCs, Provinces, Bands and Associations, Headquarter Annexes, national Secretariat, and other directorates) within the Church. Also designs, develops, and implements internal auditing policies and procedures consistent with international best practice and standards.

The incumbent is also responsible for identifying improper accounting or documentation and making recommendations for improvement to HME.

name: Directorate of Health, Wellness and Wellbeing
director: HIS EMINENCE, AP. GEN. DR. TOPE OLOFINNADE
bodyHtml:
Provides vision, develops strategy, leads, and advises HME on issues that advance the health (physical, moral, mental, and spiritual), wellness, and wellbeing of the members of the church.

The incumbent should be an effective leader who will lead the congregation to attend to the physical, mental, and spiritual health of individuals in the congregation in order to fulfill the mission of making disciples of Jesus Christ for the transformation of the world.

This position offers direct services and education for the physical, mental, and spiritual health of people of all ages so that people’s lives may become whole. The incumbent is also responsible to articulate robust ideas to constantly involve and engage the Church on health and wellness issues.

name: Directorate of Training and Capacity Development
director: HIS EMINENCE, AP. GEN. DR. I. U. OMOIKE
bodyHtml:
Provides vision, develops strategy, leads, and implements the church’s training programs and oversees the development of training needs and requirements within the Church. Sets performance metrics, evaluates productivity in the Church. The incumbent is responsible for initiating, preparing, and implementing a training and capacity development budget for the Holy Order. He is responsible to interface and explore training opportunities for the church from donor agencies and Christian-based non-governmental agencies (NGO’s).

The incumbent is also responsible for liaison with the Assistant Secretary Logistics and Special Projects and the Assistant Secretary Administration for planning an annual strategic retreat for the Advisory Board every February/year to articulate the strategic short-term, medium-term, and Long-term vision for the Church.

name: Directorate of Women's Affairs
director: HER EMINENCES MOTHER CHERUB, MOTHER SERAPH, MOTHER CAPTAIN, SUPPORTED BY OTHER HER EMINENCES AT THE ADVISORY BOARD
bodyHtml:
Provides vision, develops strategy, leads, and advises HME on issues that advance the lot of the female folks in the church.

The incumbent, who should be a woman of proven character and happily married, functions as a liaison between HME and the several female gender-based associations in the church. The person called to this position will encourage women of all ages to grow in their relationship with Jesus Christ through learning, sharing, and serving. This person will provide discipleship and leadership development, oversee and encourage Women's ministries, bands, and associations, identify spiritual gifts, and other innate and sublime qualities amongst the female folk.

The incumbent is also responsible for articulating robust ideas to constantly involve and engage the womenfolk to give them a sense of belonging and make them active participants in the development and growth of the church.

name: Directorate of Media and Publicity
director: HIS EMINENCE, SUP. AP. GEN. (DR) DERE OTUBU
bodyHtml:
The Directorate of Media and Publicity is saddled with the responsibility of
  • Repositioning, building, and protection of the Brand Image of the Church.
  • Propagation of the gospel of God by the Church through various media channels.
  • Employing the best technology and practices in the propagation of the gospel.
The Directorate also covers all ministry activities and programs of the church, ensuring all programs and materials are digitally archived, making them available for the church and world at large. They are made available in different forms: video recording, audio recording, photography, material digitization, and Press engagement.

bodyHtml: The Directorate has been saddled with the task and duty to see that the church and her properties are legally protected and to make sure that conflicts are resolved for the interest of the church. The Directorate also provides the Holy Order with all Legal services for effective Policy making.

name: Directorate of Youth Affairs
bodyHtml:
This Directorate was created as a need to entrench the discipline inherent in the word of God in our youth, as they are the future of the Holy Order. Direct the minds of the youth towards living a life of holiness, righteousness, and integrity, which is fostered by a willingness to imbibe the life of Christ as an inalienable culture.

The MZYS across the CMCs and Provinces of the Holy Order Worldwide are strengthened for optimum use, performance, and enlightened to understand that the invigoration of the Tuesday Bible Studies in their local Branches is part of their primary assignment and responsibility.

Also, embark on missions with astute doggedness and tenacity of purpose, vigorously re engineer the Mount Zion Youth Society, and transform our youths completely into veritable instruments in the hands of God, as true ambassadors of Christ who are transformed first, as God’s Kingdom citizens, and then soul winners for Christ.
